jobs.occupation: A Post doc position is available in the Grønbæk Group at Biotech Research and Innovation Centre (BRIC),
jobs.description:
We are searching for a skilled and experienced post doc with specific interest in investigating early myeloid disease, clonal haematopoiesis, metabolism and obesity.

  Our research/The group

  The focus of the Grønbæk group is Translational Haematology. The group is affiliated with Biotech Research and Innovation centre (BRIC), University of Copenhagen and Rigshospitalet (Central Copenhagen University Hospital). 

  Our overall aim is to understand the molecular mechanisms of haematological cancers and based on this; to design, develop and implement novel, scientifically based, clinical trials, with a strong focus on epigenetic therapies. This is done by bridging between clinical research at Rigshospitalet and the basic cancer biology research at BRIC, and in international collaborations with, among others, the Van Andel Research Institute, Michigan, USA and the Nordic MDS study group.

  Our location at the Copenhagen Biocentre/BRIC provides optimal conditions for interaction with the basic scientists at BRIC. The group currently consists of 14 scientists, MD/scientists and students, one clinical research coordinator, 1 research nurse and 2 biomedical laboratory scientists.

   

  The project: Deciphering the Mechanistic Links Between Obesity, Clonal Haematopoiesis and Myeloid Neoplasms.

  The current position is part of a joint project ‘Deciphering the Mechanistic Links Between Obesity, Clonal Haematopoiesis and Myeloid Neoplasms’ together with Professor George Vassiliou, Cambridge Stem Cell Institute, University of Cambridge, United Kingdom funded by a ‘Molecular Mechanisms Linking Obesity and Cancer (MMLOC)’ grant from the Novo Nordisk foundation, which supports collaborative research projects with the purpose ‘to reverse-translate clinical observations into mechanistic studies that will increase our understanding of how obesity impacts carcinogenesis’.

  Obesity is a global health issue linked to increased risk of cancer, including blood cancers such as myeloid neoplasms (MN). Many MN arise from clonal haematopoiesis (CH)—the abnormal expansion of blood stem cell clones carrying somatic mutations. Haematopoietic stem cells interact with bone marrow adipose tissue (BMAT), which increases with obesity, which may fuel CH growth and progression to MN. Epidemiological and genetic studies already suggest obesity accelerates CH, but the underlying mechanisms remain unclear.

  This project integrates large-scale population data, clinical trials, and mechanistic mouse studies to investigate these links and explore preventive or therapeutic strategies.

   

  Your job

  The project focuses on translational analyses of live frozen human cells from patient bone marrow (BM)/(BMAT) and blood samples from completed and ongoing clinical trials. We are searching for a skilled post doc who is very interactive and enjoys collaborations with other scientists – including younger scientists and clinician scientists.

  Your tasks will include:

   	
• Process of live frozen patient material from clinical trials including isolation of defined cell populations, and quality control for downstream omics 	
• Perform in-house molecular techniques which may include Proteomics, PCR, ddPCR, and library/sample preparation for RNA-seq, ATAC-seq and DNA methylation analyses 	
• Coordinate genomic, transcriptomic, lipidomic, metabolomic analyses with our internal and external collaborating laboratories and take the lead on designing relevant sub-studies, integrating and interpreting the data 	
• Help establish the practical and regulatory framework for these collaborations, including material transfer and data-sharing agreements 	
• Participate in grant and manuscript writing 	
• Present at local and international meetings 	
• Introduce lab techniques to new lab members and students 	
• Collaborate with both scientists and clinicians   Start: February 1st, 2027

  Duration: 2 years

  Profile

  We expect you to be a highly motivated and highly ambitious, independent scientist with the following qualifications: •

   	
• A PhD in Life Sciences with a preferred focus on haematology 	
• A strong background in mechanisms of normal and malignant haematopoiesis and molecular haematology techniques 	
• Comprehensive lab skills in molecular and cellular biology techniques, including work with primary human cells and cryopreserved patient material 	
• Experience with genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, lipidomics, metabolomics and ability to analyse and interpret such data 	
• Experience with running projects across research groups 	
• Strong publication and presentation record in peer reviewed journals and international conferences 	
• Excellent written and spoken English skills 	
• Very collaborative 	
• Good social skills     

  Place of employment
 The workplace is at the Bartholin Institute which is part of Rigshospitalet, University of Copenhagen. The Bartholin Institute is located at Copenhagen Biocentre/BRIC, close to the centre of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and a number of core facilities (animal unit, flow cytometry, in vivo imaging, NGS, etc.) shared between the research groups at BRIC (www.bric.ku.dk) and the neighbouring Finsen Laboratory. We have weekly journal clubs, data clubs, seminars with invited speakers and a young researchers club ASAP and our own PhD programme, MoMeD.

   

  Terms of employment 
 The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of two years. The starting date is 01.02.2027 or after agreement.
 Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation. Currently, the monthly salary starts at 39,900 DKK/approx. 5,300 EUR (August 2026 level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 18,07 % to your pension fund.

  Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions, if they hold a PhD degree and have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years.

  The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025

   

  Questions 

  For further information regarding the position, please contact Professor Kirsten Grønbæk, kirsten groenbaek@regionh.dk; phone + 4535456086 / +4525211598.

  Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility).

   

  Application
 The application must include the following documents/attachments – all in PDF format:

  1. Motivated letter of application (max. one page).

  2. CV incl. education, work/research experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position.

  3. A certified/signed copy of a) PhD certificate and b) Master of Science certificate. If the PhD is not completed, a written statement from the supervisor will do.

  4. List of publications.

   

  Recommendation 
 Furthermore, the applicant should provide two letters of recommendation or two references. To be taken into consideration, the letters must be signed by the supporting person on paper with institutional letter head and in PDF-format.

   

  Application deadline 15 November 2026, 23.59pm CET.

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications 3 of 4 or letters of recommendation that do not live up to the above-mentioned requirements.

   

  The further process

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

  The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

   

  The University of Copenhagen wish to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

Would you like an internship where your analyses help drive real business decisions? Are you excited by the opportunity to work with data, AI and modern analytics tools in an international green-tech company? Does gaining hands-on experience with Power BI, ServiceNow and Claude AI sound like the perfect foundation for your future career?

Here is what your role entails

As our new Data Analyst Intern, your responsibility will be to help Customer Services transform data into insights that support business decisions and continuous improvements.

More specifically, you will be:

• Analyzing Customer Services performance

• Identifying improvement opportunities

• Tracking costs and income streams

• Developing dashboards and tracking KPIs

• Exploring data-driven and AI opportunities

This internship offers the opportunity to work with real business challenges, where your insights create impact. You will gain hands-on experience with technologies and platforms such as Power BI, ServiceNow and Claude AI while helping shape a newly established area with plenty of room for learning and development. Furthermore, you will have the opportunity to influence your focus areas throughout the internship based on your interests and development goals.

Meet your future team

With direct reference to Head of Service Development - Heat/Cooling Customer Services, you will become part of a newly established team in Customer Services focused on service development, business processes, and data analysis. Together our mission is to enable Customer Services to continuously improve how we deliver, support, and develop services. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and you can expect close interaction with colleagues from Customer Services as well as Product Management, Sales, Software Development and Digitalization. As a team, we value knowledge sharing, professional sparring, and a strong desire to continuously improve the way we work.

Did you know? In our team, we have many different talents – we have both a former professional drummer, a race car driver and one of the best board game players in Denmark, just to name a few.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a curious and analytical student who enjoys working with data and turning insights into action. You are motivated by solving real business challenges and eager to explore how data and AI can create value in practice.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Hold a degree in Data Science, Business Intelligence, Business Analytics, Economics, or a related field

• Have strong analytical skills and is comfortable working with quantitative data

• Have an interest in working with AI and tools such as Power BI or similar visualization tools

As we are an international organization, it is important that you are fluent in English. Danish is considered an advantage, but not a requirement.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• A gratuity which may be provided in recognition of your efforts if your place of study allows it as well as paid public transportation to and from work

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Job Description

At Netcompany, we are looking for recent graduates with a bachelor’s degree who want a challenging, social and developing start to their career as an Associate Consultant. Are you excited by the opportunity to work on complex IT solutions that make a real impact, while combining hands-on development with project delivery and close client interaction?

The Associate Consultant role exists across both Consulting and Application Services. The main difference lies in how you work with clients and solutions, and which setup fits your interests best. Either a more project-oriented environment (Consulting) or a more long-term, team- and solution-driven setup (Application Services).

Responsibilities & technologies

As an Associate Consultant at Netcompany, you will contribute to translating customer needs into the right technical solutions. Depending on the project and customer, you may become part of either our Application Services or Consulting business area. In both areas, you will work closely with exciting customers and colleagues to develop and deliver high-quality IT solutions. Your work will span different projects, technologies, and domains, giving you the opportunity to continuously expand your knowledge and expertise. We work with a wide range of technologies and platforms, such as .NET, C#, Java, React, Angular, Salesforce, Microsoft, Oracle, Adobe and more.

As an Associate Consultant, you will contribute to all aspects of system development with focus on technical tasks. Your tasks and responsibilities will vary from project to project and evolve over time, but your responsibilities will typically include:

• Customer dialogue and requirements clarification.

• Development of frontend and backend features for customer solutions.

• Setup and development of frameworks, integrations, and extensions for standard platforms.

• Automation of business processes through, for example, batch jobs.

• Development of tools and scripts for data migration and other technical solutions.

About you

We expect you to hold a bachelor's degree or diploma in engineering, computer science, software, IT, or a similar field. To succeed in this role, you:

• Are newly graduated or have a couple of years of experience. Most importantly, you are passionate about taking your IT career to the next level.

• Possess strong IT technical skills within object-oriented programming.

• Have fundamental knowledge of software development and are motivated to develop your competencies.

• Think analytically, show initiative, and work in a structured way.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

Continue developing with us

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will guide you through your development and help you achieve your goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague helps ensure the well-being of each employee and provides you with concrete insights into the many different career opportunities as you build your experience.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars on everything from technologies to customer management. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills, preparing you for various tasks and continuously improving your expertise throughout your career with us.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

Complex international HVAC projects demand more than strong project plans. They require disciplined commercial leadership, reliable cross-functional execution, and timely decisions across markets, contracts, and technical disciplines.

NOVENCO are looking for a Director of Project Execution to lead NOVENCO’s project portfolio across Denmark, Netherlands, UK, DACH, APAC and US. You will strengthen how we deliver safely, profitably, and consistently from order handover to final customer acceptance and satisfaction.

****Your Impact

• Lead the Project Execution function across NOVENCO, ensuring safe, timely, profitable, and contractually compliant delivery.

• Set the functional direction, operating model, governance standards, and long-term capability roadmap for Project Execution.

• Own portfolio performance across revenue, gross margin, cash flow, working capital, forecasting, risk, quality, and customer commitments.

• Lead and develop Project Managers and project execution teams through clear priorities, effective decision rights, succession planning, and coaching.

• Align Sales, Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Finance, installation, and commissioning around common delivery plans and commercial outcomes.

• Guide major customer escalations, contractual negotiations, claims, recovery actions, and commercial decisions within NOVENCO’s delegated authority framework.

****What Drives Success

• Extensive leadership experience from international HVAC, mechanical contracting, EPC, construction, or industrial project delivery.

• Proven accountability for a complex project portfolio, including margin, cash, risk, forecasting, contracts, and customer escalations.

• Strong financial and organizational judgement that turns business strategy into clear priorities, governance, and executable plans.

• The ability to lead experienced professionals and Project managers across functions, cultures, countries, and competing commercial priorities.

• A relevant degree or equivalent experience; PMP, IPMA, PRINCE2, or comparable certification is an advantage.

****Real Impact Example

****A major international project portfolio is facing changing customer requirements, capacity constraints, margin pressure, and several contractual interfaces. You enable your team to establish a fact-based portfolio review, clarify decision rights, strengthen change control, and align Sales, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, and project leadership around a shared recovery plan. Within short time the team improves forecast accuracy, and brings critical projects back within their approved delivery plans. Just as importantly, the new governance becomes a repeatable standard across all four countries.

****What We Offer

• A leadership role with responsibility for international project execution across NOVENCO’s established markets.

• The opportunity to shape NOVENCO’s Project Execution strategy, operating model, leadership capability, and delivery standards.

• Direct influence on the commercial and operational performance of complex, technically demanding HVAC projects.

• Close collaboration with senior leadership and experienced colleagues across commercial, technical, financial, and operational functions.

• Professional development and training through NOVENCollege.

• 25 days’ annual leave plus 5 days Feriefri after the qualifying period.

• Standard auto-enrolment pension scheme and access to a healthcare scheme.

• Competitive salary and employee benefits in line with company policy.

****Context

****You will lead a team of 8-10 people across NOVENCO and report directly to the CEO. The position combines strategic functional leadership with regular engagement in major projects and customer relationships.

**How To Apply

**Please submit your CV via our careers site. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be scheduled as suitable candidates are identified.

NOVENCO Building & Industry is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

Are you motivated by how companies decide which products, technologies, and business opportunities to invest in? Do you enjoy combining market insight, customer needs, financial potential, and strategic analysis to support difficult decisions? Are you looking for an internship where you can contribute to strategic portfolio decisions in Kamstrup’s international Heat/Cooling business?

Here is what your role entails

As our intern, you will work closely with Strategic Portfolio Management on questions that influence the direction of the Heat/Cooling business. You will contribute to portfolio strategy, evaluate business opportunities, analyse the balance of the portfolio, and help prepare recommendations for prioritisation and investment decisions.

More specifically, you will be:

• Contributing to the annual portfolio strategy process for the Heat/Cooling business

• Mapping customer needs, market trends, competitor movements, and technology developments

• Analysing business opportunities and assessing their strategic fit and value potential

• Developing business cases, portfolio dashboards, and decision material for management reviews

• Supporting prioritisation discussions across development initiatives

You will take ownership of analytical assignments and contribute directly to ongoing portfolio decisions. At the same time, you will gain insight into how strategic choices are made across Product Management, Sales, Finance, and Research and Development.

Meet your future team

You will become part of our Product Management Team in the Heat/Cooling department, where you will work closely together with Strategic Portfolio Management. In Strategic Portfolio Management, we challenge ideas, prioritize business opportunities, and then support them as projects on their way to our customers. Using sales numbers, market input, customer interviews, and strategic priorities, we give guidance to the organization on what to build next. We do so by seeking out data and diverse perspectives to challenge each other’s assumptions. Otherwise, we enjoy a relaxed atmosphere, and we are not shy about celebrating successes and learnings along the way.

Less about us, more about you

Sky‑Watch A/S is a leading Danish drone company that since 2009 has specialized in the development, production, and servicing of high‑technology mini UAS systems for Defense – nationally and internationally. With more than 155+ dedicated employees and a strong international growth journey underway, Sky‑Watch today stands as one of the most innovative players within tactical mini UAV systems. At Sky‑Watch, robust, reliable, and advanced drone systems are developed for demanding environments and critical situations where predictability, mechanical durability, traceability and user safety are paramount.

As an ambitious scale-up company in rapid development, Sky-Watch continues to expand across products, markets and the organization.

To support the company’s international growth and further strengthen the strategic level of its marketing function, we are now looking for an ambitious, strategic and inspiring

Director of Marketing

Strategic Marketing Leadership – International Defense – Commercial Impact

Do you want to shape the marketing direction of a fast-growing high-tech defense company? As Director of Marketing at Sky-Watch, you will lead and develop the marketing function across Product Marketing & Strategy, Field & Event Marketing, and Brand & Digital Influence. You will strengthen the strategic level of marketing, set clear priorities and create the framework for a multidisciplinary team of specialists to succeed. At the same time, you will connect Sky-Watch’s advanced engineering capabilities with customer needs and government procurement requirements, strengthening the company’s positioning and commercial impact in international defense markets.

Working closely with Sales, Business Development and R&D, you will ensure that marketing supports strategic procurement programs, priority accounts and Sky-Watch’s international growth ambitions.

You will report to the VP Marketing and lead a marketing team of five.

Your key responsibilities include:

• 
Product Marketing & Strategy – positioning, go-to-market strategies, technical narratives, CONOPS and tender enablement.

• 
Field & Event Marketing – international defense exhibitions, live demonstrations and targeted market activities.

• 
Visual Brand Design & Digital Influence – compelling visual communication, digital narratives and consistent brand positioning.

• 
ABM & Partner Enablement – targeted initiatives towards priority accounts, procurement programs and international partners.

• 
People Leadership – develop the marketing team and create clear direction, collaboration and ownership.

To succeed in this role, you have around 10 years of experience within Marketing and Product Marketing in international high-tech companies, preferably within a regulated industry such as aerospace or defense, combined with a few years of leadership experience. You know how to set strategic direction while empowering specialists to take ownership of execution. You bring experience with Account-Based Marketing, lead generation and partner enablement and understand customer acquisition in public tender-driven markets. Experience with technical product marketing, Tier-1 accounts, international exhibitions and complex hardware and software portfolios will be important in the role, and a strong technical understanding or flair is considered an advantage.

You are based within reasonable commuting distance of Sky-Watch’s location in Støvring or Valby.

As a person, you are a strategic and results-oriented leader with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to translate strategy into execution. You provide clear direction while giving specialists the trust and autonomy to excel within their areas of expertise. You combine strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent communication and interpersonal capabilities. You are curious, adaptable and resilient in a dynamic scale-up environment and bring a collaborative and inclusive approach to leadership. With high accountability, integrity and professionalism, you are motivated by building a strong and high-performing marketing function.

Are you the new Director of Marketing at Sky-Watch? If so, please submit your application and CV as soon as possible. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity or religion. For further information about the position, please contact consultant Martin Tveit, Sensu A/S, by phone at +45 26 83 38 42.

For more information about Sky‑Watch, please visit www.sky-watch.com.

Are you an experienced Talent Acquisition (TA) professional with a strong track record in recruitment and proactive sourcing? Do you enjoy advising hiring managers, navigating challenging talent markets and finding specialist talent that is hard to reach? Would you like to help shape TA in a growing, international technology company?

Trackman is looking for an experienced TA Specialist to join our HR team at our headquarters in Hørsholm. TA is a newly established dedicated function within HR at Trackman. We are a small and collaborative team with responsibility for recruitment across the organisation.

Because we are a small team, everyone plays an important role. You will have a high degree of ownership and independence while working closely with your TA colleagues and the wider HR team. We are looking for someone who brings solid experience, can confidently run recruitment processes and sourcing activities independently, and is ready to contribute with ideas and best practices from day one.

You will join us at an exciting stage where we are continuing to develop our TA function, strengthen our sourcing capabilities and build more scalable ways of working. We value openness, collaboration and a good sense of humour. We help each other, share knowledge and ideas, and trust each other to take ownership.

What you will be doing

You will take ownership of recruitment processes and partner closely with hiring managers across the recruitment lifecycle, with a particular focus on identifying and engaging talent for specialist and hard-to-fill positions.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Drive recruitment processes in close collaboration with hiring managers, advising on candidate profiles, recruitment strategy, processes and market conditions.

• 
Proactively source and engage talent through LinkedIn Recruiter and other relevant channels.

• 
Build and maintain talent pipelines for critical profiles.

• 
Ensure smooth and effective recruitment operations, from engaging job ads to well-managed candidate pipelines in our ATS, Recruitee.

• 
Ensure a strong and professional candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.

• 
Contribute to employer branding and talent attraction initiatives.

• 
Continuously improve our TA processes and ways of working, including exploring how AI and automation can increase quality and efficiency.

Job requirements

What we are looking for

We are looking for an experienced TA professional with a strong recruitment foundation, demonstrated experience in proactive sourcing and a strong passion for the field. You are confident running recruitment processes independently, know how to navigate challenging searches and are comfortable acting as a trusted recruitment partner to hiring managers.

We imagine that you:

• 
Bring several years of solid hands-on experience within TA or recruitment, including end-to-end recruitment and proactive sourcing.

• 
Have a proven track record of managing recruitment processes from defining the profile and recruitment strategy to sourcing, assessment and closing.

• 
Know how to identify, approach and engage passive candidates, particularly for specialist and hard-to-fill profiles.

• 
Are confident advising and challenging hiring managers on candidate profiles, recruitment strategy, talent markets and hiring decisions.

• 
Can manage multiple recruitment processes and priorities while keeping things moving forward.

• 
Bring experience and perspectives that can contribute to developing and improving TA practices and ways of working.

• 
Have a strong focus on candidate experience and quality.

• 
Are curious about AI, automation and new TA technologies and how they can improve recruitment.

• 
Communicate confidently and professionally in English.

Experience recruiting within technology/engineering is an advantage, but not a requirement.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

Join IO Interactive’s Finance team at our Copenhagen Studio as Finance Director and play a key role in shaping the financial direction of a multi-studio, multi-entity games company. You will lead the Finance function, drive the automation of the finance processes, and act as the CFO's trusted partner and second-in-command. Responsible for the day-to-day leadership of Finance while providing strategic, financial, and commercial guidance that supports IO Interactive's continued growth across all studios.

If you are a strategic finance leader who combines commercial understanding with strong technical expertise, we would love to meet you.

Please note that our finance team is primarily based in Copenhagen, and we would love local leadership; this position requires you to be on-site at our Copenhagen studio.

What you will do

Finance Leadership

• 
Lead the day-to-day Finance organisation across IO Interactive's global studios.

• 
Manage, drive, mentor, and develop Finance team members while building a high-performing and collaborative function.

• 
Drive the ongoing project of full automation of the finance process

• 
Act as the CFO's right-hand and trusted sparring partner on both operational and strategic matters.

• 
Ensure strong financial governance, controls, compliance, and scalable finance processes across the organisation.

Financial & Business Leadership

• 
Own budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning across all studios and entities.

• 
Provide strategic financial insight and recommendations to the CFO and senior leadership team.

• 
Translate financial and operational performance into clear actions and business recommendations.

• 
Support decision-making related to investments, headcount planning, studio growth and organisational development.

• 
Partner with Production, Commercial, Technology and Corporate leadership on financial performance and business priorities.

• 
Drive performance management through meaningful reporting, KPIs and financial analysis.

Controlling & Governance

• 
Upscale and improve Financial and Business controlling.

• 
Oversee Accounting, Financial Controlling and Business Controlling activities across the organisation.

• 
Ensure accurate management reporting and financial visibility across studios, projects and functions.

• 
Oversee external audits, statutory compliance, and financial risk management.

• 
Support finance transformation, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Who you are

• 
Significant experience in a senior Finance leadership role.

• 
Strong background across Accounting, Financial Controlling and Business Controlling.

• 
Experience leading and driving Finance teams in a complex international organisation.

• 
Strong commercial mindset with the ability to influence strategic business decisions.

• 
Experience partnering with executive stakeholders and senior leadership teams.

• 
Excellent understanding of financial reporting, governance, planning, and performance management.

• 
Strong leadership skills and ability to operate as a trusted advisor.

We would love it if you had

• 
Experience working in the gaming industry.

• 
Previous experience in an audit firm earlier in your career.

• 
Experience supporting multi-studio, multi-entity, or international organisations.

• 
Experience with ERP transformations

• 
Experience with Unit4 or similar ERP systems.

• 
Experience with Prophix or similar systems.

• 
Accounting qualification such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CMA or equivalent.

Who we are:

IO Interactive is an independent video game development and publishing company with studios in Copenhagen, Malmö, Barcelona, and Brighton. As the creative force behind some of the most talked-about multiplatform video games in the last decade, we are committed to creating unforgettable characters and experiences—powered by our award-winning, proprietary Glacier technology.

IOI is a studio that values in-person collaboration. Being together helps us focus our collective energy on our immediate goals. For us, being both in-office as well as connected across our studios helps us integrate our teams faster, strengthen relationships, and improve knowledge-sharing. We believe that the more time we spend together, the more quality and progress we achieve for our games and players.

We know that to achieve those goals, we need courage, talented people, and a great working environment—and we do our utmost to have all of that. Across our multiple studios, we’re working on several projects. Crucially, though, we’re all one team. We value the work and impact that each person brings to the table, and we actively encourage new ideas whilst listening to your insights along the way.

With more than 50 nationalities, we know that everyone is different, and we are proud to have a reputation for being a friendly workplace with highly talented people.

We're looking for a highly motivated and commercially-driven sales professional with a passion for building long-term customer relationships and delivering sales results. The ideal candidate will have an established network across academia, pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, hospitals, and industrial research, together with a proven track record of managing multiple territories and complex sales cycles. They will be proactive, self-motivated, and comfortable working independently, while collaborating closely with colleagues across engineering, product development, and marketing to continually improve the customer experience, sales strategy, and product offering. Above all, they will enjoy engaging with customers, identifying new opportunities, and helping shape the future growth of Clair Scientific through a flexible, hands-on approach that extends beyond traditional sales responsibilities. Candidates will be evaluated on a continuous, rolling basis.

**The Role

**As a Senior Sales Specialist at Clair Scientific, you will support the commercial growth of our automated microscopy platform across multiple territories and market segments. Leveraging an extensive network spanning academia, pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, hospitals, and industrial R&D, you will identify opportunities, build strategic relationships, and drive revenue growth while helping build our global sales organization.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• 
Own the complete sales cycle from strategic lead generation to contract closure.

• 
Develop business across multiple territories and international markets.

• 
Leverage an established network across academia, pharma, biotech, hospitals, and industry.

• 
Build relationships with researchers, core facilities, procurement teams, executive stakeholders and distributors.

• 
Represent Clair Scientific at conferences and customer meetings worldwide.

• 
Develop sales strategy, CRM processes, pricing, forecasting, and channel partnerships.

• 
Gather market intelligence and customer feedback.

• 
Mentor and support future commercial team members.

**Qualifications

**

• 
3+ years of scientific instrument sales experience.

• 
Demonstrated success managing multiple territories and complex sales cycles.

• 
Extensive professional network across academia, pharmaceutical, hospitals, and industrial sectors.

• 
Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

• 
Willingness to travel internationally.

**Overview

**Corti is the frontier lab for clinical-grade AI, building world-leading models and infrastructure for the realities of healthcare.

Our technology powers healthcare’s most ambitious software, from EHR vendors and virtual care platforms to the health systems that care depends on. We work with builders ranging from fast-moving startups to global healthcare enterprises, helping them bring clinical AI into real-world care.

Healthcare is full of problems where AI has to do more than simply work. Clinicians are overwhelmed by documentation. Coding errors, backlogs and denials cost health systems billions. And the specialist expertise patients need is not always available when they need it.

We build AI specifically for these environments, trained on real patient interactions, validated against real outcomes, and designed to perform where accuracy, trust and reliability matter. If you want to help define how AI is built for healthcare, you belong at Corti.

The Role

We’re looking for a GTM Engineer to help build the systems behind a smarter, more scalable go-to-market engine at Corti. You’ll connect the tools and data that power our commercial teams, turning fragmented systems into a reliable foundation for automation, insight, and action.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of software, data, and business impact. You’ll partner closely with Growth, Sales, DevEx Growth, and Platform to design workflows, improve data quality, and build the internal products and automations that help us move faster as we scale.

What you'll do

Data foundation

• Build and maintain the integrated data layer across Corti’s commercial data systems, bringing together data from tools such as Stripe, Attio, Supabase, Calendly, and Leexi.

• Own the event tracking layer, instrumenting key product and commercial touchpoints so analytics tools (PostHog, Mixpanel, etc.) reflect what's actually happening.

• Build enrichment pipelines that pull from third-party data providers and internal signals to keep ICP records current and scored.

Systems and automation

• Design and implement workflows, automations, and backend services that improve how commercial teams operate, from pipeline management and deal acceleration to post-sale handoffs.

• Identify repetitive GTM processes and systematically eliminate them through automation, freeing commercial teams to focus on higher-judgment work.

Activation and tooling

• Build systems that surface timely signals and enable proactive, data-driven GTM execution, including AI-powered internal tools and agentic workflows where appropriate.

• Build internal tools that reduce manual work for sales, CS, and growth, such as automated account research, meeting prep summaries, or usage-based alert systems.

• Partner with Growth and RevOps to define the data models and pipeline logic that underpin campaign targeting, segmentation, and attribution.

Cross-functional impact

• Collaborate as the primary technical builder for GTM teams across Growth, Enterprise Sales, Developer Experience, and Scaled Customer Experience, translating process needs into robust, scalable solutions.

• Document all built components so systems remain understandable and extensible as the team scales.

• Contribute to engineering quality through clean implementation, thoughtful code review, and cross-functional collaboration.

What you bring

• Experience as a software engineer, ideally at mid-level, with exposure to growth, sales, or other go-to-market teams.

• Strong proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript, with a backend or server-side engineering focus.

• Experience integrating business-critical tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, or similar systems.

• Familiarity with analytics and data tooling such as PostHog, Mixpanel, Segment, Google Analytics, Amplitude, or Google Tag Manager.

• Experience working with ETL processes, data synchronization, or workflow automation is a plus, but not required.

jobs.description:
**Overview

**We are on a mission to ensure everyone has access to medical expertise, no matter where they are.

Half the world still lacks access to quality healthcare. Even in advanced systems, outcomes are uneven, and clinicians are overwhelmed. Medical knowledge grows faster than human capacity can keep up.

Corti exists to close that gap. Our AI platform expands access to medical expertise, reducing errors, restoring time to clinicians, and making care more affordable, accessible, and human again.

There is no quality healthcare without a quality dialogue, and no reliable AI without a strong foundation. Help us build both.

**Why Corti?

**Corti is the frontier lab for clinical-grade AI. We build world-leading models and infrastructure that power healthcare's most ambitious software - from EHR vendors and virtual care platforms to the health systems that care depends on. Today, Corti serves over 100 million patients annually, including the NHS.

Our flagship model, Symphony, is trained and validated on real clinical data from real patient interactions, and powers the clinical and administrative work that healthcare runs on.

We power the builders who are redefining how healthcare works, from startups creating new patient experiences to enterprises modernizing the systems that care depends on.

If you believe that AI purpose-built for medicine will define the next century of healthcare, you belong at Corti.

**The Role

**Are you a curious person, and interested in contributing to solving real problems in healthcare? Are you someone who loves the Golang programming language?

If so, we would love for you to become an integral part of a fun, autonomous, and team-oriented culture guided by shared values, a high bar for quality, and a willingness to experiment.

Join the Engineering team as a Senior Backend Engineer to be part of pioneering the development of healthcare products. Our team specifically focuses on developing software that assists the medical community within speech recognition. Your work will build the backend that helps the medics, nurses, and doctors learn from their calls to get better for each one. You will learn every day by working alongside experts in software engineering, machine learning, and data science—are you up for the adventure?

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Own the technical development of a product that differentiates Corti the most in the market

• Your development work will impact millions of medical consultations a year at a global scale

• Hands-on development of an innovative solution where design choices matter

• Collaborate across our product and platform teams to define and improve best practices across Corti

• Work with colleagues in design and code reviews

• Bridge technical communication between end-users, technical leads, and Corti engineers

• Contribute to a strong culture of development at Corti through mentorship of developers of all levels

**What You Bring

**

• Extensive experience as a backend developer

• Mastery of Golang

• Experience ideating and implementing features with high complexity

• Hands-on experience with cloud computing architecture and development

• Deep experience with software and product development processes - you have seen where problems can arise, know how to deal with them, and how they can be proactively avoided

• Experience running, monitoring, and operating REST, WebSockets, and GraphQL APIs

• You know what it takes to design intuitive and user-friendly APIs

• Experience with containers and orchestration tools

• A passion for writing clean and efficient code

• Understand what it takes to build integration with other systems used in healthcare would be a bonus

• Experience designing data storage solutions is a plus

• Experience with audio streaming is a big plus

• General knowledge of IP telephony, on a conceptual or protocol level would be favorable

**Life at Corti

**

• You will be reporting to the Senior Engineering Manager.

• The position is full-time and starts as soon as possible.

• Hybrid working environment in our Copenhagen Office

• Equipment provided by Corti

**Ready to dive into the world of Corti? Hit that 'Apply' button, and let's start working together on reshaping the dialogue in healthcare, making a real difference for millions of patient outcomes around the world.

**_🤝 Bringing in top talent from all backgrounds is crucial in our pursuit to improve the world of healthcare. We encourage applications from all people and do not discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, and/or disability status.

_At Corti, experience comes in many forms, and we’re passionate about creating teams with a multitude of perspectives! If you believe your experience is close to what we’re looking for but not an exact match, we still hope you’ll consider applying!

**Overview

**Corti is the frontier lab for clinical-grade AI, building world-leading models and infrastructure for the realities of healthcare.

Our technology powers healthcare’s most ambitious software, from EHR vendors and virtual care platforms to the health systems that care depends on. We work with builders ranging from fast-moving startups to global healthcare enterprises, helping them bring clinical AI into real-world care.

Healthcare is full of problems where AI has to do more than simply work. Clinicians are overwhelmed by documentation. Coding errors, backlogs and denials cost health systems billions. And the specialist expertise patients need is not always available when they need it.

We build AI specifically for these environments, trained on real patient interactions, validated against real outcomes, and designed to perform where accuracy, trust and reliability matter. If you want to help define how AI is built for healthcare, you belong at Corti.

**The Role

**We are looking for an engineer passionate about building the next generation of high-scale audio processing infrastructure for communication centers that form a vital part of our critical infrastructure, including emergency dispatch centers and hospitals. You will be responsible for integrating AI capabilities into environments dominated by network protocols like SIP and SIPREC, ensuring robust and scalable performance at the heart of life-critical operations.

**What You'll Be Doing

**

• Architect and maintain systems processing over 100,000 calls per day.

• Develop foundational infrastructure using network protocols such as SIP and SIPREC.

• Integrate AI capabilities into low-latency, high-throughput audio processing pipelines.

• Collaborate with the Platform Engineering team with a commitment to engineering excellence to ensure system reliability and scalability.

• Hands-on development of an innovative solution where design choices matter

• Work with colleagues in design and code reviews

• Contribute to a strong culture of development at Corti through mentorship of developers of all levels

**What You Bring

**

• Master of Golang

• Deep understanding of network protocols, specifically SIP and SIPREC

• Proven track record of building and scaling foundational infrastructure

• Experience in ideating and implementing features with high complexity

• Hands-on experience with cloud computing architecture and development

• Experience running, monitoring, and operating REST, WebSockets, Kafka or an event-driven architecture

• Experience with containers and orchestration tools

• A passion for writing clean and efficient code

• Experience with WebSocket, gRPC and CockroachDB is a significant plus.

• Experience with real-time audio processing and WebRTC is a significant plus.

• Excellent English verbal and written communication skills, including all-remote communication
